name: lms_stream
status: RTL + models + cycle-accurate simulation + isolated core synthesis; no board image, P&R, timing, or hardware qualification

interfaces.output: m_tdata={e[31:16],y[15:0]} signed16 Q1.15 each, m_tuser={bypass,clip}, m_tvalid/m_tready
interfaces.configuration: atomic {taps,mu,nlms,update_en,floor,coef_clr} valid/ready handshake accepted only when drained; cfg_done pulse; cfg_taps<1 or >NTAPS -> cfg_error, state preserved
interfaces.coefficient: cw_en/cw_addr/cw_data write port (wins over commit); rb_en/rb_addr -> rb_valid/rb_data registered readback (pre-edge value, 1-cycle latency)

implementations.IMPL=0: serial MAC, II ~= 2*taps+7 (LMS) / +34 (NLMS), 3 DSP, delayed-commit visibility 1 sample
implementations.IMPL=1: full parallel pipeline, II=1 for NTAPS<=8, latency NL+31 to output register, commit visibility NL+31 samples (delayed LMS)

rounding: nearest ties to even on magnitude (negative-safe), identical to infra/fixedpoint
saturation: y/e sat16, t2 sat18, NLMS gain sat20 via fp_div guard, coefficient sat24; clip flag accumulates all events

nlms.energy: incremental tap-window sum of squares, E_den = min(e2>>16, 2^20-1)
nlms.floor: update bypassed when E_den < max(cfg_floor,1); bypass reported on m_tuser[1]
nlms.division: exact signed RNE g=RNE(t2*2^8/E_den) via shared fp_div core; div0 unreachable through floor, still guarded

simulation.command: python tests/test_lms.py (iverilog fixture-driven cycle oracle, both impls, plus MULT_DSP=0 equivalence twin)
simulation.coverage: LMS/NLMS mixed traffic, random valid/backpressure, resets, cfg rewrites incl. illegal taps, cw preload + rb readback sweep, saturation extremes, energy-floor bypass, freeze; 8 mutated-negative checks per run

core_synthesis.command: python tests/synth_lms.py (yosys read_verilog -sv; synth_gowin -top lms_stream; no -family)

limitations: core-only: no wrapper/chain integration, no P&R or board timing
parallel impl exceeds the <=4 DSP board-image guidance (35 DSP); serial impl is the budget-compliant option (3 DSP)
parallel NLMS commit latency creates delayed-LMS dynamics; demonstrated stable at mu <= 0.125
energy window cleared on config change; assumes contiguous sample history between configs
